name: singlet_annotation_cell_ontology_mapping
title: Cell Ontology term mapping for cell type labels
description: Maps each unique free-text cell type label to one term of a pinned Cell Ontology release, or to no term. The default normalised_index method matches CL labels and exact synonyms offline and deterministically; method ols queries the EBI Ontology Lookup Service and is cached. Writes obs/cl_term_id, obs/cl_match_type and uns/cl_label_map. Do not use it to assign cell types from expression; use an annotation task for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

label_column.description: obs column of free-text cell type labels; mapped once per unique label.

cl_release.description: Pinned Cell Ontology release identifier; required, because mappings are not reproducible without it.

candidate_root.description: Restrict candidates to descendants of this term; the default is the animal cell root.

method.description: normalised_index is deterministic and offline; ols calls the EBI Ontology Lookup Service.

obsolete_policy.description: replace_by follows replaced_by of an obsolete target; abstain leaves the label unmapped.

device.description: Execution device; the current methods run on CPU, so auto selects CPU.

dry_run.description: Return unique label count, uncached lookup count and estimated seconds without mapping.

overwrite.description: Replace existing cl_* members instead of failing.

normalised_index.description: Options for method normalised_index; ignored by ols.

use_synonyms.description: Match CL exact synonyms as well as labels; related synonyms are not used.

synonym_table.description: Path to a versioned abbreviation table; its checksum is written to the report.

tie_break.description: When several active terms share a normalised label: abstain, or report their lowest common ancestor.

ols.description: Options for method ols; ignored by normalised_index.

cache_remote.description: Cache responses keyed by normalised label and service version.

top_k.description: Candidate terms kept per label for review.

fuzzy_fallback.description: Repeat a failed exact query as a fuzzy query; the first CL hit depends on ranking.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: mapped inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/cl_term_id. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Mapping summary for completed calls: unique_labels, n_mapped, n_unmapped, n_collisions, match_type_counts, cl_release, method, service_version, cache_hit_rate. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
